## History

Baxter is married to [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) and notably changed his religious denomination from [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) to [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist). His switch occurred simply because the [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) choir was singing 'Behold the bridegroom cometh' as a collection piece when he and [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) walked up the aisle the Sunday after their wedding.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P18](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0018)_
